counting_scope: Each RESULT branch contains its own cumulative counts; trial sums include all four selected and unselected branches. Internal branches are never external R.
CW_directed_savings: N(N-1) directed savings entries fully constructed and traversed on normal CW return; derived exact total verified against installed VeRyPy enumeration, not a partial-error counter
Routing_limit_checks: Shared active CustomLimit predicates, incremented before testing count>=limit; native clones/restarts share the same Python counter
Routing_limit_acknowledgements: Further predicate calls after stop requested; not additional budgeted exploration
CP_calls: Completed client CpSolver.Solve calls, seed/final separately visible in stage events
CP_conflicts: Native client solve NumConflicts, summed; 256 parameter is per internal SAT solve and is NOT an upper bound on this total
CP_solutions: Improving-solution callback entries; entry 8 is retained before StopSearch
LP_calls: Native linprog calls, including post-round closure solves
LP_iterations: Sum of native linprog nit, not IP internal simplex iterations
IP_calls: Primary and, when incumbent exists, secondary native milp calls each count; native mip_node_count recorded per call in work.jsonl
day_pattern_attempts: Increment before overlap/infeasibility/duplicate checks; includes rejected and duplicate work
pricing_rounds: Two complete passes over the original CW routes per branch, using the SAME base LP duals; no intermediate LP refresh is implied
pricing_calls_attempted: Each (round,original CW route index), before construction/sampling; failures consume their registered call with no retry
classical_permutations_evaluated: Number of full macro permutations enumerated/constructed, including repeated round domains; NOT AOA energy-function evaluations. D/W and physical evaluation occurs in shared downstream catalogue/master/completion
quantum_objective_requests: Requests entering the sampled objective guard, including an excess rejected request in defensive-boundary tests
quantum_training_attempts: Actual sampled-objective callback entries accepted under the 80 cap; includes initial evaluation and failed evaluation; optimizer iterations and last-x cache hits are different quantities
quantum_training_successes: Objective callbacks that computed a sampled value
quantum_training_failures: Objective callbacks raising an exception; no unregistered retry
quantum_optimizer_initial_preparations: SciPy ScalarFunction preparations, which perform the initial objective evaluation
quantum_optimizer_value_requests: SciPy PRIMA requests to ScalarFunction.fun, including last-x cache reuse
quantum_optimizer_cache_hits: A fun request that did not increase ScalarFunction.nfev; no extra sampled objective or shots consumed
quantum_training_tensor_calls: One-hot tensor state evaluations used for training, including attempted failed evaluations; NOT full Qiskit circuit executions
quantum_training_sampling_calls: NumPy multinomial sampling attempts; actual shots counted only on successful return with sum(counts)
quantum_training_shots: Observed multinomial counts summed after normal sampling return, exactly10000 per recorded successful sampling; planned ceiling is not substituted
quantum_final_circuit_calls: Final execution_state build/evolution attempts; separate from successful states
quantum_validation_tensor_calls: Independent tensor-state checks of final state, not training objective evaluations or sampled shots
quantum_final_sampling_calls: Statevector.sample_counts attempts, distinct from final state/circuit creation
quantum_final_shots: Observed sum(final counts), exactly10000 on a completed final sample call
unknowns: Missing interrupted measurements remain unknown/null or a missing count key; observed partial event totals are labeled observed, never promoted to complete totals
optimizer_stop: history optimizer_message/nfev/success is raw SciPy output. Reaching max evaluations or trust-region return is not proof of optimality or convergence
